title_zh: AGY Roundtable v5.7.2 — 超长上下文零打断协同升级（跨轮全员热会话 Delta 复用 · 公平配额零误剪 · 协商 6.5K 原文保真 · 彻底消除 Antigravity 左侧空项目）
title_en: AGY Roundtable v5.7.2 — Uninterrupted Ultra-Long Context & Clean Sidebar Release (Full-Squad Cross-Round Delta Reuse, Zero-Clip Fair Budgeting, 6.5K Consult Fidelity & Zero Empty Antigravity Projects)
highlights_zh: 彻底消除 Antigravity 2.0 左侧栏自动冒出「空项目」：移除 `agy_adapter.py` 中触发幽灵项目的 `--new-project` 回退逻辑，遇 `empty conversation id` 直接走干净退避重试，配合 `--add-dir` 在 CLI 默认隔离区无污染读写任意课题目录
多轮超长上下文 100% 完整评审、零漏人零误剪：按模型真实窗口（Gemini 4 1M / GPT-6.2 272K）自适应扩展讨论与终稿预算至 72K–96K，修复公平注水配额 `-72` 偏移（总长未超预算时 100% 逐字原样送达），L0 优先保护窗扩至 10 条且跳过已折叠协商初稿
圆桌跨轮全员热会话 Delta 复用与精准水位遥测：修复 Codex 多波次并行命令缺失 `reasoning` 时的 API 轮次误折叠（改为并发在途工具 `0 → 1` 跃迁计数），消除 90% 虚假水位钳位与虚假换乘，实现第 2 轮全员（Codex + Antigravity）无缝热复用，单次完整圆桌耗时缩短约 25%
增强 `@team_consult` 跨席核验与状态库瘦身：队友协商回复原文直通上限提至 6.5K（超长时同时保留首段判定、核心锚点与尾段纠偏建议），自动折叠协商前旧草稿，并无损去重 `team_state.json` 瘦身约 40%~65%
highlights_en: Eliminates ghost empty projects in the Antigravity 2.0 desktop sidebar: removed the `--new-project` fallback in `agy_adapter.py`; transient `empty conversation id` errors now recover via clean backoff retries while `--add-dir` grants target workspace access without polluting the sidebar

Uninterrupted multi-round peer review with zero dropped speakers & zero spurious clipping: adaptive 72K–96K L0 budgets for 272K/1M models, fixed `-72` water-fill offset for 100% verbatim delivery whenever messages fit, and expanded 10-slot live priority window excluding folded drafts

Full-squad cross-round hot Delta session reuse & exact peak telemetry: replaced Codex tool-batch counting with `0 -> 1` in-flight burst tracking (immune to omitted `reasoning` events), eliminating false 90% clamps & rollovers and cutting real 2-round wall-clock time by ~25%

Higher-fidelity `@team_consult` & leaner persistence: verbatim peer consult reply limit raised to 6.5K chars with anchor+tail-preserving compression, automatic superseded pre-consult draft folding, and lossless `team_state.json` deduplication
